CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.work_snapshot(p_work works)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(

$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.references_snapshot(p_work_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'title',r.title,'relation',r.relation,'url',r.url
  ) order by r.created_at,r.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  from public.work_references r where r.work_id=p_work_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_published_in_hierarchy(p_work_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with recursive chain as (
    select id,parent_work_id,status,1 as depth from public.works where id=p_work_id
    union all
    select w.id,w.parent_work_id,w.status,c.depth+1
    from public.works w join chain c on w.id=c.parent_work_id where c.depth<13
  )
  select coalesce(count(*)>0 and bool_and(status in ('published','open'))
    and bool_or(parent_work_id is null) and max(depth)<=12,false) from chain;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.work_quota_day_start(p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''

  SELECT date_trunc('day',p_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_empty_work_group(p_kind text, p_body text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_kind='collection' THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(p_body,''),'[[:space:]　]+','','g')='' ELSE false END;
$function$
